name: Functional Analysis and Applications
description:
Review of Basic Concepts: Metric spaces and basic concepts. 
Normed and Inner Product Spaces: Normed linear spaces, Inner product spaces, Banach spaces, Hilbert spaces, Properties and examples, Geometric concepts in inner product spaces., Schauder basis and separability. 
Bounded Operators: Bounded linear operators, Examples and properties, Bounded linear functionals, Dual spaces of some concrete Banach spaces, Weak convergence. 
Closed and Compact Operators: Closed operators, Compact operators, Examples, Some simple properties and applications. Fundamental Theorems in Functional Analysis: Hahn-Banach extension theorem, Applications of Hahn-Banach extension theorem, Uniform boundedness principle, Closed graph theorem, Open mapping theorem. 
Hilbert Space Theory: Riesz representation theorem and some applications, Orthogonal complements, Projection theorem, Compact self-adjoint operators, Spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators.
